title: Canonical-cycle formula for the specified bottom comparison
statement: Let C,D,S,n be as in [new-def-pc-derived-bottom-comparison], and write delta for that explicitly constructed natural isomorphism. For every cochain complex K, let L be the unique lift of S applied to the canonical cycle inclusion of K into the canonical cycles of S(K), characterized by L followed by the target cycle inclusion equalling S of the source cycle inclusion. Then L followed by the canonical homology quotient of S(K), the inverse localization/homology comparison, degree-n homology of the actual right-derived unit, degree-n homology of RS applied to the lower-truncation projection, and delta at QK equals S applied to the canonical homology quotient of K followed by its inverse localization/homology comparison. No arbitrary homology data T,U or map k occurs.

source.place: 05TC (2), double truncation and the degree-zero left-exact comparison; 08D4 (1) and the 0AVW cohomology display.

proof.text: Expand the specified bottom comparison into its explicit initial double-truncation isomorphism, shifted single-object comparison, and inverse lower-truncation homology projection. This factorization is proved by unfolding the concrete constructions and reassociating.

Apply the canonical-cycle transport equation. Apply the proved integer-degree single-object unit normalization. Map composition under S and cancel the lower-truncation homology map with its inverse. The unchanged canonical-cycle normalization follows.

theorem normalized_bottom_unit_formula
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C]
    [EnoughInjectives C] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} C]
    {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} D]
    (S : C ⥤ D) [S.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits S] (n : ℤ)
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    ((((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).liftCycles
        (S.map (K.sc n).iCycles) (by
          change S.map (K.sc n).iCycles ≫ S.map (K.sc n).g = 0
          rw [← S.map_comp, (K.sc n).iCycles_g, S.map_zero])) ≫
      (((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).homologyπ ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D n).app
            ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)).inv ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
            (S.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
            (S.rightDerivedFunctor.map
              ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) ≫
          (S.rightDerivedFunctorTruncatedBottomIso n).hom.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
        S.map ((K.sc n).homologyπ ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors C n).app K).inv)
